dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about Drunkard Gorge.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: This used to be a popular route for all the merchant caravans. I used to set up my stall in the canyon to earn a few Mora too...

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: Occasionally the odd monster would show up, and if so you just chalk it down to bad luck.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: But now, everyone's fled the canyon and the merchant caravan is stuck here with no way through.

dialogues.speaker: Farrah
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's not the end of the world if I can't sell the fruit, but if it goes rotten that's another story...
